text:
Morgan Barron has eight points in his last ten games, about double what his ice time would usually bring, and he scored on Thursday. Our numbers call the run partly real: his own chances are up a little, but finishing is doing most of the work.

The five-on-five picture is rough. Winnipeg takes 39% of the expected goals with him on (expected goals measure the quality of chances), about ten points worse than without him, and the Jets have scored about four more goals than their chances with him out there. He is a penalty-killing, hitting fourth-liner, 58 hits, and his offense lives in transition: 59% of his shots come off the rush in Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking. A sixth-round pick out of Cornell, he has carved out more than 300 games in Winnipeg. Enjoy the points; our range has him around 16 goals, and the run will cool.
